definitions.explanation: Expresses strong confidence that something will happen or is true. Used when the speaker feels certain about a prediction or expectation.

examples.japanese: {明日|あした}はきっと{晴|は}れますよ。
examples.english: It will surely be sunny tomorrow.

examples.japanese: きっと{大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}ですよ。
examples.english: I'm sure it will be fine.

notes: Expresses a higher degree of certainty than たぶん (probably). Often used to encourage or reassure someone. Usually written in hiragana. Can be used with both positive and negative predictions.
